title: Perturbed beam-walking task
description: This dataset contains synchronized 128-channel EEG, lower leg and neck EMG, EOG, and motion capture recordings from participants standing or walking on a treadmill-mounted balance beam while exposed to sensorimotor perturbations. Perturbations were either virtual-reality visual field rotations or side-to-side waist pulls. Each participant completed four 10-minute sessions with 150 perturbation events each. The dataset supports study of electrocortical and muscular responses to balance perturbations.
methods_description: Participants completed four 10-minute same-day sessions of standing or walking at 0.22 m/s on a treadmill-mounted balance beam (2.5 cm tall, 12.7 cm wide). Each session had 150 perturbations, balanced across directions: visual field rotations (0.5 s) or waist pulls (1 s). EEG (128 channels), EMG, EOG and motion capture were recorded synchronously. Good channel indices and ICA matrices are stored in EEG.etc of each .set file.
